title: Reproducible batch-image software
intro: Turn a source-verified segmentation prototype into a deterministic and auditable multi-image pipeline with tests, explicit axes, metadata, output manifests and clean reruns.

scientific_context.caution: Candidate masks are unvalidated biological objects. A reproducible program is not by itself a reliable detector.

chapter_method: Predict → Run → Investigate → independent Prove → delayed review; run local A06 batch CLI and source-safe reproduction.

goals.title: Separate pure processing from file I/O
goals.why: A pure transformation can be tested without a microscope, filesystem, GUI or hidden notebook state.
explain: An array-processing function should take inputs and return values without modifying source data.
Convert unsigned source arrays to float before background subtraction.
The exported count remains a candidate pixel count, not biologically validated cells.

# TASK: Given data.fields with field_id,animal_id,pixels, threshold, count >
#   threshold per field and group by animal. Return
#   result = {'field_counts': dict, 'animal_means': dict,
#             'source_fields': int, 'biological_n': int,
#             'candidate_only': True}.
# INPUTS: data from lesson panel
# OUTPUT: assign your answer to result

assertions: result['field_counts']=={r['field_id']:sum(v>data['threshold'] for line in r['pixels'] for v in line) for r in data['fields']}

result['animal_means']=={a:sum(result['field_counts'][r['field_id']] for r in data['fields'] if r['animal_id']==a)/sum(r['animal_id']==a for r in data['fields']) for a in sorted({r['animal_id'] for r in data['fields']})}
result['field_counts']=={r['field_id']:sum(v>data['threshold'] for line in r['pixels'] for v in line) for r in data['fields']}

result['animal_means']=={a:sum(result['field_counts'][r['field_id']] for r in data['fields'] if r['animal_id']==a)/sum(r['animal_id']==a for r in data['fields']) for a in sorted({r['animal_id'] for r in data['fields']})}

build_steps: Prespecify input source metadata, format and full segmentation parameters.
Keep pure array transformations separate from file I/O.
Generate one auditable per-field record and biological-unit summary.
Reproduce locally in A06 CLI and inspect source hashes and failure-handling.

review.title: Delayed reproducibility and provenance audit
review.why: A successful rerun without identical source and configuration is not exact reproducibility.
explain: Check all data/process identity fields before interpreting output differences.
Environment drift may not alter numeric outputs but must be recorded.
A clean checkout and fresh execution are still required outside the browser.

worked_example.predict: Predict what changes when source, parameters or biological identity changes.

review.prediction_answer: Require source data, configuration and experimental-unit identity before comparing derived outputs.
walkthrough: Predict a failure condition before running the example.
Change one dimension, source value or manifest entry and inspect output.
Explain which scientific interpretation requires external annotation or a fresh local run.
investigate: Try a missing file, repeated ID or alternate parameter value.
Separate reproducible candidate masks from validated target detection.
review.debug_task: Identify one failure where a script runs successfully but reports a misleading scientific result.
review.misconception: A successful Python run implies every biological label and sample unit is correct.
review.scientific_boundary: Synthetic browser inputs. Source integrity, full TIFF batch execution and fresh-environment reproducibility require A06 local Python; candidate masks are not validated nuclei.

feedback.hardcoded: Compute from changing input metadata and image values; never hardcode fixtures.
